title: Data model: ContentShape records and a shape field on content items
description: Add a ContentShape model (id/key, title, description, sortOrder, enabled, typicalLength, shelfLifeDays, pinnable, hasOwnPage, defaultSectionIds, writerGuidance, classifierGuidance, boardColor, boardIcon, audit fields) with Administration-style authorization (editors read, admins write; IAM/authoring role for operators), and an optional shape key on Item/content item versions (and assignments where useful). Include the GraphQL indexes needed to list shapes in order and stories by shape. No seed YAML; an empty table means no shapes.
